title: Six fresh passages: first software result before Qwen
instructions: More Qwen work is underway. This fixed study has six fresh source passages and three identical calls per passage. This first real software output is visible before expansion to the model calls. Optional comments can steer the work; no routine permission is needed to continue.

questions.prompt: Optional notes on these fresh inputs and results

evidence.label: First new passage: a Senate request about a petition
evidence.text:
Inputs — full original OCR from the first frozen passage:
The PRESIDENT pro tempore. It is moved and seconded that the Senator from Illinois be authorized to withdraw from the Committee on Military Affairs the petition presented by him which was referred to that, committee by order of the Senate some time since.

Expected output — my direct source-image reading, recorded before seeing model replies; one reader, not accepted benchmark truth:
The PRESIDENT pro tempore. It is moved and seconded that the Senator from Illinois be authorized to withdraw from the Committee on Military Affairs the petition presented by him which was referred to that committee by order of the Senate some time since.

Actual output — full first pass from the software:
The PRESIDENT pro tempore. It is moved and seconded that the Senator from Illinois be authorized to withdraw from the Committee on Military Affairs the petition presented by him which was referred to that, committee by order of the Senate some time since.

Differences — the software raises 11 inspection flags and selects secondary inspection of the whole passage. A flag is not a verified error. This is the first real software sample from a fixed six-passage study, selected as the two longest unused primary passages in each of parts 3–5. Three identical model calls per passage are planned, 18 calls maximum; no model call has run. The reserved sample is untouched. Images and text are not replaced after seeing the outcomes.
